article.story: HAMDEN, Conn. -- — Stefanos Spartalis had 20 points and 14 rebounds as Monmouth beat Quinnipiac 74-70 on Thursday night. Ashton Walker added 14 points while shooting 6 for 13, including 2 for 4 from beyond the arc for the Hawks (1-2). Torrey Brooks Jr. shot 4 of 10 from the field, including 1 for 3 from 3-point range, and went 4 for 4 from the foul line to finish with 13 points. Tayeshawn Cunningham-Pemberton finished with 18 points and two steals for the Bobcats (2-2). Quinnipiac also got 17 points and four assists from Lucas Sekasi. Nas Hart also had 10 points and 14 rebounds. Walker scored nine points in the first half and Monmouth went into halftime trailing 37-36. Monmouth pulled off the victory after a 9-0 second-half run broke a 46-46 tie and gave the Hawks the lead at 55-46 with 11:01 remaining in the half. Spartalis scored 14 second-half points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
